meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把产品介绍网址、粘贴的脚本或简短说明,变成一支产品发布或宣传视频。它会先抓取网页素材,再设计画面风格、写故事板和脚本,逐帧生成网页帧,最后渲染出 mp4 视频文件。
howto.when: 当你想宣传、发布、推广或展示某个产品时,它会接管;商业网址默认走这个流程,网站巡览或展示类请求也归它处理。意图不明确时,会转给 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个产品介绍网页做成一支发布宣传视频。
say.note: Claude 会先抓取网页素材,再生成故事板和脚本。

say.text: 帮我把这段产品脚本做成 30 秒的发布视频。
say.note: 脚本会作为旁白素材使用。

say.text: 用这个链接做一支网站展示视频,按页面原样展示。
say.note: 这类请求会用真实截图当画面,保留原貌。

howto.what_en: Turns a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: captures site assets, sets a design style, writes storyboard & script, builds frame HTMLs, and renders MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; default for any commercial URL. Site tours/showcases of a website route here too. Unclear → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this product introduction page into a launch promo video.
say_en.note: Claude captures the site assets, then writes storyboard and script.

say_en.text: Make a 30-second launch video from this product script.
say_en.note: The script is used as the narration source.

say_en.text: Make a site showcase video from this link, showing the page as-is.
say_en.note: Site tours keep the real screenshots as visuals.
